name: DI-WMF-FYP public scientific code snapshot
scope: Frozen Python source and original requirements only; README and result subsets are maintained separately.

explicit_source_exclusions.reason: Submission/package audit, outside the public scientific-code subset.
Manuscript/package builder, outside the public scientific-code subset.
Poster-layout builder, outside the scientific experiment/figure subset.
Manuscript generator containing a private installation path and CID field.
Historical package verifier; not needed for source execution and differs in the current checkout.

excluded_categories: Raw image and physiological datasets, processed reference waveforms and predictions
Checkpoints, tensors, per-run histories, configurations, logs and participant-level records
Manuscript source, personal metadata, original package manifests and local release documents
Unselected archive/package builders and manuscript/poster preparation scripts
dependency_caveats: h5py is imported by regression code but absent from the byte-preserved requirements-review.txt; install it separately.
Historical first-layer repair execution needs original configurations and filters_initial.pt, not included in this code subset.
Patient-group repair execution needs historical registry/configuration/checkpoint records and independently acquired datasets.
Frozen nested sources and historical v1 variants are retained as provenance; do not flatten their paths or treat every script as a standalone launcher.
The original environment uses PyTorch 2.8.0 and torchvision 0.23.0; several training and timing paths require CUDA.
provenance_note: These are preserved source snapshots from the assembled research release, not recovered experiment-time Git commits.
manifest_self_exclusion: PUBLIC_CODE_MANIFEST.json is not included in its own files array.
